benchmark_items.problem_description: I need to reproduce the gas-phase fragmentation study of anionic cuprate complexes from solution and measure their collision-induced dissociation patterns. What physical instrument setup should I use?
benchmark_items.analysis_goal: Identify the ionization plus trapping/fragmentation setup used for gas-phase CID analysis of anions.
expected_causes: negative-ion electrospray ionization to transfer anions into the gas phase
mass-selected collision-induced dissociation in an ion trap with He collisions

best_match: ESI source + quadrupole ion trap CID setup
negative-ion electrospray ionization into a quadrupole ion trap

evidence_text: transferred into a three-dimensional quadrupole ion trap via negative-ion mode electrospray ionization (ESI)
mass-selected, accelerated to higher kinetic energies, and allowed to collide with the He atoms present in the ion trap
A subsequent m/z scan identified the resulting fragment ions
